sample_rule: Within Category.primary_category, sort by ascending SHA-256 of the UTF-8 string gui-dna-webgen-v1: followed by the exact site id, then by site id. Take the first two per category; include every functional check on every sampled site.
information: Generation may use the website instruction. Keep ui_instruct, expected outcomes and judge traces on the evaluator side. Freeze per-arm build scope, reusable reference provenance, judge version and common budget before evaluation.
endpoint: Official functional browser-agent judgment, summarized separately from the Web-Bench task-file verdict.
